question.html:
The question assesses knowledge of single-slit diffraction, path difference, diffraction grating properties, and the conditions for coherence within the context of wave phenomena (C.3).

a A microwave source emitting waves of frequency is directed at a single slit of width . Calculate the angular position, in radians, of the first minimum of the resulting diffraction pattern. Assume the speed of microwaves is . [2]

b Two loudspeakers are connected to a single signal generator and emit a frequency of in a room where the speed of sound is . A point in the room is located from one speaker and from the other. Deduce whether the sound intensity at point is a maximum or a minimum. [2]

c A beam of monochromatic light is incident on a diffraction grating. Discuss how the resulting pattern of principal maxima changes if the grating is replaced by another one that has a significantly larger number of lines per millimeter. [3]

d State the two conditions that must be met for two wave sources to be considered coherent. [2]
